verdict.rationale: Decagon documents Simulations, an integrated testing suite for validating agent behavior across channels before production deployment and on every update. Duet can also generate tests across diverse pathways that check accuracy, policy adherence and brand fit, which covers the simulated-conversation path of the story. Its production A/B Experiments are not pre-launch testing and were not credited. Missing for 10: explicit replay or testing against historical tickets, depth on how simulations are built and scored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: Simulations, Decagon's integrated testing suite, help teams validate agent behavior across channels before deploying to production and with every subsequent update.
Use Duet to easily generate tests covering diverse pathways that verify whether agents respond accurately, follow policies, and reflect your brand.
